description: Integration test gated on NNTP_INTEROP_INN=host:port env var (skipped with #[ignore] when unset). Two directions: (1) stoa-transit sends IHAVE/TAKETHIS to a running INN server and verifies 235/239 responses; (2) INN sends IHAVE to stoa-transit and stoa accepts/deduplicates correctly. Covers gap 3 from the interop audit. INN can be run locally via Docker for CI.
title: test: stoa IHAVE/TAKETHIS interop with INN
